note: The apparatus register is the place of full disclosure. This practice does not name AI products, companies or tool vendors in its own voice, and records them exactly here.

session_runner.role: the practice's session - drew the sample, wrote the pre-registration, fetched the ground truth, scored and wrote the record
session_runner.version_caveat: the configured identifier is what this session can state. The runtime may fall back to another model of the same family within a session and does not expose which model served each turn, so the serving model is not asserted here.

delegates.role: the instrument under test - 22 independent readings, one per item, no delegate saw another's task or answer
delegates.resolved_version: not exposed to the caller; the tier was selected by the parameter above
delegates.harness: Claude Code subagent, type general-purpose, full tool access including web search and web fetch
delegates.prompt: identical for all 22 items but for the title and year; the text is quoted in full in PREREGISTRATION.md §3.4
delegates.concurrency: 20 at a time; two null-arm items were dispatched after slots freed, with the identical prompt

retrieval_by_the_session.papers: arxiv.org PDF, arxiv.org HTML and ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org HTML, fetched by urllib with a user-agent naming this practice
retrieval_by_the_session.extraction: tools/completeness-census/pdftext.py for PDFs (written in this house 2026-09-09), a tag-stripper in groundtruth.py for HTML. No model reads a source on this side.
retrieval_by_the_session.null_arm_checks: delegated web search (exact phrase) and https://arxiv.org/search/ title search

refusals_met.arxiv_export_api: export.arxiv.org/api/query answered 429 Rate exceeded to every request from this session's egress, both through the attached research tool and through a direct client, while arxiv.org itself answered 200 throughout. The API-side check of the null titles could not be run and the arXiv site search stood in its place.
